https://wirenorth.example/brightloom-see.body:
Brightloom raises EUR 3 million

Helsinki-based Brightloom has raised EUR 3 million in a seed round led by Aurora Ventures to expand its energy analytics platform across the Nordics.

Brightloom's software forecasts electricity demand for industrial sites and recommends when to shift production to cheaper, cleaner hours.

The company plans to double its engineering team in Helsinki and open a sales office in Stockholm next year.
